pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
name: Wuppertal
registryBasis: Wuppertal’s official Open Data page and catalog identify weekly updated ALKIS parcel polygons, approximately 100,000 parcels, under DL-Zero. The official NRW simplified ALKIS WFS advertises parcel features without owners; its schema exposes a safe parcel key and full MultiSurface geometry. A bounded exact-WUP-point query returned one full parcel polygon and key. This proves a point sample only, not citywide completeness or runtime readiness.
scopeLimits: Seven valid distinct NRW ALKIS cadastral references verified in thirteen bounded 0.001-degree cells around the unchanged Wuppertal WUP settlement locator. Complete offset paging, forced three-row geometry pages, all seven fresh exact native cadastral identities, explicit absence, footprint and source binding passed in twenty requests. Independent metric EPSG:32632 GEOS found all geometries valid and distinct, with no sampled overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. Existing official North Rhine-Westphalia OGC API and native flstkennz namespace are reused. The original exact-point WFS sample and API polygon share the same native key; independent projected comparison finds Hausdorff distance 0.000006263 metres and symmetric difference 0.0099301 m², consistent with the two published CRS transformations, rather than byte-identical coordinates. Both complete source shapes remain unchanged. Wider municipal completeness, legal title, survey accuracy, currentness and long-term identity continuity remain unverified.
remainingUncertainty: The exact-point WFS response and source identity are verified. Citywide completeness, polygon validity/topology at scale, long-term key stability, and a runtime adapter are not reviewed. The city bulk GeoJSON is ~98 MB; the bounded WFS route is preferable.
nextStep: Root may review the WFS source and sample, then perform source-level bounded quality/coverage tests before qualifying runtime.

officialSources.observation: Official city page documents approximately 100,000 weekly updated ALKIS parcel polygons and DL-Zero licensing.
Official city data portal lists the ALKIS parcel dataset and GeoJSON/Atom distributions.
Official catalog API identifies the complete GeoJSON distribution and city-published Atom feed.
Official NRW WFS capabilities describe a direct-access download service for simplified ALKIS parcels without owner data.
Official schema exposes `flstkennz` and `geometrie`; only these two fields were requested.
Exact WUP-point GetFeature request returned one full parcel feature, with only `flstkennz` and `geometrie` requested.
